name: UQ Indigenous Australians Scholarship
summary: One-year scholarship for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander UQ undergraduates facing financial hardship.
key: $4,500 (subject to the annual distribution from the relevant fund and may be more or less in some years).
who: Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander person.
Enrolled in any undergraduate program in the year of the award.
how: Apply using the online application form. One application covers all scholarships in the Aspire Scholarship scheme and related schemes.
catches: Applications opened 17 August 2026 and close 26 February 2027.
